name: garlic

definition.en: a plant bulb made of small parts (cloves) with a very strong taste
definition.tr: güçlü tadı olan, dişlerden oluşan bitki soğanı
definition.de: eine Zwiebel aus kleinen Zehen mit sehr kräftigem Geschmack
definition.fr: un bulbe fait de petites gousses, au goût très fort
definition.it: un bulbo fatto di spicchi, dal sapore molto forte
definition.es: un bulbo formado por dientes, de sabor muy fuerte

de.gloss: split (old klieben: the bulb splits into cloves)

origin: Old English gārlēac: gār (spear, for the leaf shape) + lēac (leek)

sentences.tr: Bu sosta çok fazla sarımsak var.
sentences.de: In dieser Soße ist zu viel Knoblauch.
sentences.fr: Il y a trop d'ail dans cette sauce.
sentences.it: In questo sugo c'è troppo aglio.

sentences.en: Some people say [garlic] keeps colds away.
sentences.tr: Bazıları sarımsağın soğuk algınlığını uzak tuttuğunu söyler.
sentences.de: Manche sagen, Knoblauch hält Erkältungen fern.
sentences.fr: Certains disent que l'ail éloigne les rhumes.
sentences.it: Alcuni dicono che l'aglio tiene lontano il raffreddore.
sentences.es: Hay quien dice que el ajo aleja los resfriados.
